snippet.title: Polterquest - New Game Coming Soon To Steam and Mobile Platforms
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3630330/Polterquest/

In Polterquest you play as the "coolcat" exploring haunted places and finding treasures. Game is a 3d action adventure platformer in which you need to solve certain puzzles to progress as well as defeating enemies along your journey.
